intro: Sir S. J. Erlgadin demands that you prove yourself worthy of the big game hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition. Following your initial cull of younger beasts, he challenges you to track down and slay ten fully grown panthers in the wilds of Stranglethorn Vale.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now you're ready to turn it up a notch. If you want to prove yourself worthy of socializing with the likes of these big game hunters, you'll need to prove that you can kill 10 panthers.
Those big boys are tougher. They're not as easy as the young ones you were killing earlier.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Go kill 10 panthers! Show us what you've got!
